categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes an indefinite IBD stall where an inbound or manual peer answering with empty headers holds the single sync slot forever.
Restores headers sync liveness for node operators using addnode connections to peers that are also in IBD.

result.summary: This PR releases an inbound or manual peer from the initial headers sync slot when it returns an empty headers message while the local best header is stale. It also institutes a retry delay on that peer and cancels its download deadline, allowing another eligible peer to take over headers synchronization.
result.problem: During initial headers sync, a node assigns a single peer to fetch headers. If an inbound or manual peer returns an empty headers response because it is caught up or also in IBD, it continues holding the sync slot indefinitely because automatic eviction does not apply, preventing the node from asking other peers and stalling sync.

categories.evidence: Modifies headers sync assignment and message handling in src/net_processing.cpp
categories.rationale: Fixes a confirmed bug where initial headers sync can stall indefinitely (issue #34096). While outbound peers are protected by eviction logic, manual and inbound peers currently retain the sync slot upon returning empty headers, preventing progress across eligible peers.

result.card: This PR prevents initial block download from stalling indefinitely when an inbound or manual peer returns empty headers while the node is behind. It fixes issue #34096 by clearing the sync-started state, cancelling the download deadline, and applying a retry backoff to the peer so an eligible alternative peer can take over. The change is small, targeted at src/net_processing.cpp, and has Concept ACKs from multiple contributors.
